description:
To join our product team, we are looking for a Fullstack web developer with proven experience in working with:
- PHP (good knowledge)
- API development and debugging experience
- SQL (good knowledge)
- HTML & CSS
- JavaScript (vanilla & frameworks Vue/React)
- Mobile App Development

If you are motivated and passionate about Web Development, you master HTML, CSS and JavaScript very well, you have experience in working with VueJs or React and you have good PHP and SQL knowledge, please consider applying for this job posting.

You will be working on developing, further extending and upgrading of an existing online music service, focused on the mass market in Africa, but also internationally.
